categories.name: Demographic Information
categories.description: Baseline non-modifiable demographic factors influencing baseline population diabetes prevalence.

fields.name: age
fields.label: Age
fields.tooltip: Age in years. Type-2 Diabetes incidence strongly escalates after age 45 due to progressive pancreatic beta-cell dysfunction.

fields.name: sex
fields.label: Biological Sex
fields.tooltip: Biological sex recorded at baseline.

fields.name: race_ethnicity
fields.label: Race / Ethnicity
fields.tooltip: Self-reported race or ethnic background. Certain populations (e.g. South Asian) exhibit higher diabetes predisposition at lower BMIs.

fields.name: education_level
fields.label: Education Level
fields.tooltip: Highest level of formal educational attainment, acting as a socio-economic determinant.

fields.name: income_level
fields.label: Household Income Tier
fields.tooltip: Relative household socioeconomic income stratum.

categories.name: Inherited Susceptibility (PRS)
categories.description: Synthetic Polygenic Risk Score (PRS) representing aggregate inherited polygenic liability. (Not an actual clinical genetic test).

fields.name: t2d_prs
fields.label: Type-2 Diabetes PRS (Z-score)
fields.tooltip: Polygenic Risk Score normalized as a Z-score (Mean ~ 0, SD ~ 1). Values > 1.0 indicate top quartile genetic susceptibility.

fields.name: prs_percentile
fields.label: PRS Population Percentile
fields.tooltip: Synthetic population rank of genetic susceptibility (0% to 100%).

fields.name: genetic_risk_category
fields.label: Genetic Risk Category
fields.tooltip: Categorical partition: Low (<20th percentile), Medium (20th-80th percentile), High (>80th percentile).

categories.name: Family History & Pedigree Risk
categories.description: Recorded parental, sibling, and second-degree pedigree occurrences of diagnosed Type-2 Diabetes.

fields.name: mother_diabetes
fields.label: Mother with Diabetes
fields.tooltip: Does the participant's biological mother have diagnosed Type-2 Diabetes?

fields.name: father_diabetes
fields.label: Father with Diabetes
fields.tooltip: Does the participant's biological father have diagnosed Type-2 Diabetes?

fields.name: sibling_diabetes
fields.label: Sibling with Diabetes
fields.tooltip: Does any biological sibling have diagnosed Type-2 Diabetes?

fields.name: grandparent_diabetes
fields.label: Grandparent with Diabetes
fields.tooltip: Did any biological maternal or paternal grandparent have Type-2 Diabetes?

fields.name: family_diabetes_history
fields.label: Any Family Diabetes History
fields.tooltip: Positive indicator if at least one first- or second-degree relative has diabetes.

fields.name: num_affected_relatives
fields.label: Number of Affected Relatives
fields.tooltip: Total count of first- and second-degree biological relatives diagnosed with diabetes.

fields.name: family_history_score
fields.label: Weighted Family History Score
fields.tooltip: Pedigree-weighted metric: 1.0 per affected parent/sibling, 0.5 per affected grandparent.

categories.name: Modifiable Lifestyle Factors
categories.description: Daily physical activity, sleep patterns, dietary habits, smoking, alcohol, and perceived psychological stress.

fields.name: physical_activity_minutes_week
fields.label: Physical Activity
fields.tooltip: Total minutes of moderate-to-vigorous physical exercise per week. WHO guideline recommended minimum is 150 min/week.

fields.name: moderate_activity_days
fields.label: Moderate Activity Days
fields.tooltip: Days per week engaging in moderate aerobic physical activity (e.g., brisk walking, cycling).

fields.name: vigorous_activity_days
fields.label: Vigorous Activity Days
fields.tooltip: Days per week engaging in vigorous exercise (e.g., running, heavy resistance training).

fields.name: sedentary_hours_day
fields.label: Sedentary Screen / Sitting Time
fields.tooltip: Average daily waking hours spent sitting or reclining.

fields.name: sleep_duration_hours
fields.label: Sleep Duration
fields.tooltip: Average nightly sleep duration. 7 to 8 hours is associated with optimal insulin sensitivity.

fields.name: sleep_quality_score
fields.label: Sleep Quality Score
fields.tooltip: Subjective sleep quality index based on sleep continuity and restfulness (0-100).

fields.name: fruit_intake
fields.label: Fruit Intake
fields.tooltip: Daily servings of fresh, unprocessed whole fruits.

fields.name: vegetable_intake
fields.label: Vegetable Intake
fields.tooltip: Daily servings of non-starchy green and colored vegetables.

fields.name: whole_grain_intake
fields.label: Whole Grain Intake
fields.tooltip: Daily servings of complex whole grain foods (oats, brown rice, whole wheat).

fields.name: processed_food_frequency
fields.label: Ultra-Processed Food Intake
fields.tooltip: Daily servings of ultra-processed packaged meals, fast foods, or refined snacks.

fields.name: sugary_drink_frequency
fields.label: Sugary Drink Intake
fields.tooltip: Daily consumption of sugar-sweetened beverages or sodas.

fields.name: diet_quality_score
fields.label: Diet Quality Score
fields.tooltip: Composite dietary adherence score reflecting healthy dietary patterns (0-100).

fields.name: smoking_status
fields.label: Smoking Status
fields.tooltip: Smoking history status.

fields.name: smoking_pack_years
fields.label: Smoking Pack-Years
fields.tooltip: Cumulative smoking exposure: (packs smoked per day) x (years smoked). 0 for never-smokers.

fields.name: alcohol_use
fields.label: Alcohol Consumption
fields.tooltip: Does the participant consume alcoholic beverages?

fields.name: alcohol_frequency
fields.label: Alcohol Frequency
fields.tooltip: Frequency of alcoholic beverage intake.

fields.name: stress_level
fields.label: Perceived Stress Level
fields.tooltip: Self-reported chronic psychological stress index (0-100).

categories.name: Clinical & Anthropometric Parameters
categories.description: Standard objective clinical indicators, including anthropometrics, hemodynamics, and serum lipid panels.

fields.name: bmi
fields.label: Body Mass Index (BMI)
fields.tooltip: Weight in kilograms divided by height in meters squared (kg/m²). Key risk driver.

fields.name: waist_circumference
fields.label: Waist Circumference
fields.tooltip: Abdominal visceral adiposity measurement in centimeters.

fields.name: systolic_bp
fields.label: Systolic Blood Pressure
fields.tooltip: Upper resting blood pressure reading in mmHg.

fields.name: diastolic_bp
fields.label: Diastolic Blood Pressure
fields.tooltip: Lower resting blood pressure reading in mmHg.

fields.name: hypertension
fields.label: Diagnosed Hypertension
fields.tooltip: Clinical history or ongoing medical diagnosis of hypertension.

fields.name: cholesterol
fields.label: Total Serum Cholesterol
fields.tooltip: Total circulating blood cholesterol in mg/dL.

fields.name: triglycerides
fields.label: Serum Triglycerides
fields.tooltip: Fasting blood serum triglycerides in mg/dL.
